description: Design preset (item 1): lasso is default tool after preset switch; Space+drag pans.
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
k = rng.integers(0, 3, 2000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 4, (3, 6))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (2000, 6)), columns=[f'f{i}' for i in range(6)])
df['cat'] = [f'g{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: set Design preset
steps.eval: a.navSettings = { ...a.navSettings, preset: 'design' }; a.applyPresetDefaults('design'); a.renderer?.setNavSettings(a.navSettings, a.dims, () => a.tool)

steps.name: Design: tool is lasso after preset change
